summary: Client side of an effect the server controls (born in dialogues/act1-idle with ServerControlledEffectReference/Attached). Read by ecl::ServerControlledEffectSystem per-frame step bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1FF8760 zeroes it; bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0 passes the component start as a position-like argument to a beam/effect update (FUN_14189e8e0). Live world-coordinate-like floats (43.4, 17.0, -420.8) or 0.

fields.name: Translate
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0 copies +0xC (8 bytes) and +0x14 (4) into the translation slot of a transform it builds. Creator writes 0; live 0.

fields.name: RotationQuat
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0 copies +0x18 and +0x20 (16 bytes) into the rotation slot of that transform. Creator: zero with 1.0 at +0x24 (w); live (0,0,0,1).

fields.name: Scale
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0: `s = *(float*)(c+0x28); if (s < 0) s = 0;` written as uniform scale (x,y,z) of the transform. Creator 0; live 1.0.

fields.name: _Pad2C
fields.evidence: padding (creator zeroes it as part of an 8-byte store)

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: Creator null. bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0 checks IsEntityAlive on it and resets it to null when dead; looked up first (FUN_140f24fc0) to find the visual to attach to; when +0x55 is set and this is null a detach request is issued. Live entity handles.

fields.name: field_40
fields.evidence: Creator null; bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0 uses it as the fallback lookup when +0x30 gives nothing, and passes it to the beam update. Live 0/handles.

fields.name: Effect
fields.evidence: Creator writes -1 (8-byte store of 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF over +0x48/+0x4C). bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0 looks +0x48 up in the global resource manager (gGlobalResourceManager+0x50) - an effect resource id. Live FixedString-like values.

fields.name: field_4C
fields.evidence: Creator -1; passed by address to the beam update together with +0x50. Live values or empty (bone/attachment name?).

fields.name: field_50
fields.evidence: Creator -1; passed by address to the beam update. Live always empty.

fields.name: field_54
fields.evidence: Creator 0 (32-bit store over +0x54..+0x57); passed to the beam update. Live 0/1.

fields.name: field_55
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1EA88B0: `*(c+0x55) |= flag`; when set and Target is null a detach request is issued. Live 0/1.
